pages.text: This book gathers $(bold)every redstone-relevant block and item$() in Novus and sorts them by what they $(italic)do$() — sense, wire, decide, act, read — rather than by which mod they came from.$(br2)Vanilla comes first. If you already know redstone, skim $(italic)Foundations$() and start at $(l:3_wiring/red_alloy_wire)Wiring$().
pages.title: About this Book

pages.text: $(bold)What's not here.$() $(italic)Create$() has so much redstone of its own that it keeps its own book — the $(italic)Create Compendium$(). This catalogue lists Create's redstone parts in $(l:8_beyond/create)Create & Beyond$() and points you there for the detail.$(br2)$(italic)Botania$() redstone interfaces live in the $(italic)Lexica Botania$(); they're noted here, explained there.
pages.title: What's Elsewhere

pages.text: $(bold)Recipes.$() Open $(italic)EMI$() and look an item up — it shows the recipe and every use. This book explains $(italic)behaviour$(); EMI handles ingredients.
pages.title: Recipes & EMI
